records.Japanese:
ここまでは大丈夫かのう？
さて、これからは航海士のこと、つまり
わしらのことについて教えよう
records.previous_English: Still with me? Now let me explain the navigators--people like us.
records.english: Still with me? Now let me explain the navigators--people like us.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: Julio checks that Rafael is following, then introduces the navigators, including himself.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: The opening question and 'people like us' keep Julio's direct, familiar teaching voice.

records.Japanese:
提督の大事な仕事のひとつに
『人事』というものがある
records.previous_English: Assigning duties is one of an admiral's important jobs.
records.english: One of an admiral's main jobs is assigning duties.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: Assigning people their duties is one of an admiral's important jobs.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: The sentence leads with the admiral's responsibility and keeps 'assigning duties' together.

lines: One of an admiral's main jobs
is assigning duties.

records.Japanese:
航海を快適に行うために
それぞれ航海士の担当を決める
わけじゃな
実際に甲板を見ながら行うのじゃ
records.previous_English: To keep things running smoothly, you'll assign each navigator a duty. Let's do that while looking at the deck screen.
records.english: Give each navigator a job so the voyage goes smoothly. Let's do that in Deck View.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: To make the voyage go smoothly, give each navigator a duty while looking at the Deck screen.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: Give the reason and the instruction in Julio's spoken voice, using the label the player sees.
protected_phrases: Let's do that in Deck View.

lines: Give each navigator a job
so the voyage goes smoothly.
Let's do that in Deck View.

records.Japanese:
まず、艦長はFIじゃ
艦長がいないと船はうごかん
勝手にどこかへ行くわけにはいかん
からのう
records.previous_English: First, you're the captain, FI. A ship can't sail without a captain. It can't choose where to go on its own.
records.english: First, you're the captain, FI. A ship can't sail without a captain. It can't choose where to go on its own.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: Julio says Rafael is the captain. A ship needs a captain and cannot sail off by itself.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: The repetition makes Julio's point conversationally. Preserve all four rows, the normal F and the live name.

records.Japanese:
次は、操帆手じゃな
風に対して帆の角度を調節してくれる
マストの数と同じだけの操帆手が
必要じゃ
records.previous_English: Next is the Sail Handler. They adjust the angle of the sails to the wind. You'll need one for each mast.
records.english: Next is the Sail Handler. They adjust the angle of the sails to the wind. You'll need one for each mast.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: A Sail Handler adjusts the sails to the wind. Each mast needs one.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: The title, explanation and required number are all clear in the right order.

records.Japanese:
それから、操舵手じゃ
船を速く回頭させたいなら重要になって
くるぞい
records.previous_English: Helmsmen make the ship turn fast.
records.english: When you need to turn the ship quickly, the Helmsman is the one to count on.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: The Helmsman matters when you want the ship to turn quickly.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: Julio describes the role in the circumstances where it matters; the next line expands on skill.

lines: When you need to turn the ship
quickly, the Helmsman
is the one to count on.

records.Japanese:
海戦の時でも、操舵手が優秀じゃと
船を素早く、有利な位置に
持っていくことができるように
なるわけじゃ
records.previous_English: A skilled helmsman can quickly maneuver the ship into a favorable position in battle.
records.english: A skilled helmsman can quickly maneuver the ship into a favorable position in battle.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: A skilled helmsman can maneuver the ship quickly into an advantageous position during battle.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: The second sentence develops the previous turn with the maneuvering example and its tactical payoff.

records.Japanese:
それから、副官。いなくても船は
動くのじゃが、いれば、他勢力と交渉が
できるし、航海中、みんなが疲れにくく
なる。縁の下の力持ちじゃな
records.previous_English: Then there's the First Mate. You can sail without one, but having one lets you negotiate with other powers and helps everyone tire less quickly at sea. An unsung hero.
records.english: A First Mate is optional, but lets you negotiate with other powers and keeps the crew from tiring so fast at sea. An unsung hero.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: A ship can sail without a First Mate, but the job enables talks with other powers and reduces fatigue at sea. Julio calls it important work that goes unnoticed.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: Make the two benefits easy to follow and keep Julio's warm compliment as its own sentence.

lines: A First Mate is optional, but lets
you negotiate with other powers
and keeps the crew from tiring
so fast at sea. An unsung hero.

records.Japanese:
測量士がいれば『自動移動』ができたり
艦隊の緯度経度が分かるようになる
けっこう重要な仕事じゃぞい
records.previous_English: A Surveyor lets you use automatic movement and tells you the fleet's latitude and longitude. An important job, that.
records.english: With a Surveyor, you can use Auto Move and see the fleet's latitude and longitude. It's an important job.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.source_meaning: A Surveyor allows automatic movement and gives the fleet's latitude and longitude. It is fairly important.
records.context: Julio checks whether Rafael has followed the lesson. He explains how to assign navigators, what each Deck job does and which jobs are enough for ordinary sailing. A system panel then tells Rafael how to open Deck View.
records.localization_note: Use the game's Auto Move label so the player can connect the lesson to the command. Keep both coordinates.

lines: With a Surveyor, you can use
Auto Move and see the fleet's
latitude and longitude.
It's an important job.
